subject.title: fix(msteams): reset sessions on app removal lifecycle

question: Should `resetSessionEntryLifecycle` and the harness `reset` handoff become the supported permanent Plugin SDK contract for external lifecycle-driven session resets?
rationale: The Teams behavior is well supported, but accepting a new public session mutation API and harness-owner hook establishes compatibility obligations that automated correctness review cannot choose.

options.title: Approve the narrow contract
options.body: Keep the documented guarded reset API and owner handoff, then refresh the branch and merge after exact-head checks remain green.

options.title: Expose only scoped runtime access
options.body: Keep the core implementation internal and require plugins to use an owner-scoped runtime method without a direct public session-store export.

options.title: Pause the API expansion
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers identify an existing lifecycle owner path that can implement the Teams fix without adding a permanent SDK method.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow contract
recommendation.body: Keep the documented guarded reset API and owner handoff, then refresh the branch and merge after exact-head checks remain green.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history shows direct review and implementation involvement in this Teams lifecycle scope and recent adjacent session-runtime work.
